description: Post-processing recipe for synthesized speech: one global afftdn NF43 pass, then optional local spectral cleanup and HF90 attenuation on caller-provided time regions.
notes: Regions are per-recording and must be supplied by the caller; there is no automatic region detection.
0.90 is a high-band amplitude coefficient, not a measured 10% breath reduction.
Do not run the global NF43 pass twice on the same audio.
